text: きみは　もう　はくぶつかん　けんがくした？

structure.jp: はくぶつかん　けんがくした？

patterns.name: もう〜た
patterns.span: もう　はくぶつかん　けんがくした
patterns.explanation: もう with a past verb means the thing has already been done. を is dropped after はくぶつかん, as often happens in casual talk. もう　はくぶつかん　けんがくした = 'have already toured the museum'.

patterns.name: 〜する
patterns.explanation: する added to an action word turns it into a verb; した is its past form. けんがくした = 'went and looked around'.
